title: World Football Leagues
description: The top professional football leagues from around the world

leagues.name: English Premier League
leagues.nickname: The Most Watched League in the World
leagues.description: England's top football division — broadcast in 189 countries to 3.2 billion people

famous_clubs.name: Manchester United
famous_clubs.fun_fact: Most successful Premier League club with 13 titles — Sir Alex Ferguson managed them for 26 years

famous_clubs.name: Manchester City
famous_clubs.fun_fact: Won 4 Premier League titles in a row from 2021 — Pep Guardiola's team plays beautiful passing football

famous_clubs.name: Arsenal
famous_clubs.fun_fact: The Invincibles — went the entire 2003/04 season unbeaten (38 games)

famous_clubs.name: Liverpool
famous_clubs.fun_fact: 6-time European champions — their anthem You'll Never Walk Alone is sung by fans worldwide

famous_clubs.name: Chelsea
famous_clubs.fun_fact: Won the Champions League twice and have some of the world's most expensive transfer records

famous_clubs.name: Tottenham Hotspur
famous_clubs.fun_fact: Their new stadium opened in 2019 and hosts NFL games too — the pitch slides away to reveal an artificial turf

famous_clubs.name: Aston Villa
famous_clubs.fun_fact: Former European champions — won the 1982 European Cup

leagues.name: La Liga
leagues.description: Spain's top division — home to Real Madrid and Barcelona, the two most successful clubs in European history

famous_clubs.name: Real Madrid
famous_clubs.fun_fact: The most successful club in Champions League history with 15 titles — The Royal Club

famous_clubs.name: Barcelona
famous_clubs.fun_fact: Home of Messi for 17 years — Camp Nou is the largest stadium in Europe

famous_clubs.name: Atletico Madrid
famous_clubs.fun_fact: Won La Liga twice in the 2010s under Diego Simeone's defensive masterclass style

leagues.el_clasico: Real Madrid vs Barcelona is the most watched club football match in the world — hundreds of millions tune in

leagues.name: Bundesliga
leagues.description: Germany's top division — known for the best stadium atmosphere and largest average attendances in world football

famous_clubs.name: Bayern Munich
famous_clubs.fun_fact: Won 11 consecutive Bundesliga titles from 2013 to 2023 — the longest consecutive run in any major European league

famous_clubs.name: Borussia Dortmund
famous_clubs.fun_fact: Has the loudest stand in world football — the Sudtribune (South Stand) holds 25,000 standing fans

famous_clubs.name: Bayer Leverkusen
famous_clubs.fun_fact: Won their first ever Bundesliga title in 2024 — undefeated all season!

leagues.name: Serie A
leagues.nickname: The Calcio — Home of Tactical Football
leagues.description: Italy's top division — known for tactical genius and producing legendary defenders

famous_clubs.name: Juventus
famous_clubs.fun_fact: Won 9 Serie A titles in a row from 2012 to 2020 — Italy's most successful club

famous_clubs.name: AC Milan
famous_clubs.fun_fact: 7-time European champions — shared San Siro with city rivals Inter Milan

famous_clubs.name: Inter Milan
famous_clubs.fun_fact: Only Italian club to win the treble (league, cup, and Champions League) — did it in 2010 under Mourinho

famous_clubs.name: AS Roma
famous_clubs.fun_fact: A club built on passion — their ultras create one of the most atmospheric experiences in European football

famous_clubs.name: SSC Napoli
famous_clubs.fun_fact: Named their stadium after Maradona — won Serie A in 2023 for the first time in 33 years

leagues.name: Ligue 1
leagues.description: France's top division — recently known for huge money signings like Neymar and Mbappe

famous_clubs.name: Paris Saint-Germain (PSG)
famous_clubs.fun_fact: Signed Neymar for a world-record £200m in 2017 and briefly had Neymar, Mbappe AND Messi — the most expensive squad ever assembled

famous_clubs.name: Olympique de Marseille
famous_clubs.fun_fact: The only French club to win the Champions League — did so in 1993

famous_clubs.name: Olympique Lyonnais
famous_clubs.fun_fact: Won 7 consecutive Ligue 1 titles from 2002 to 2008 — the greatest run in French football history

leagues.name: UEFA Champions League
leagues.description: Europe's elite annual club competition — the pinnacle of football for any club
leagues.format: Group stage then knockout rounds — final is one match at a neutral venue
leagues.anthem: The famous Handel-inspired Champions League anthem plays before every match

memorable_finals.fun_fact: Two injury-time goals from Sheringham and Solskjaer — the greatest comeback in Champions League history
The Miracle of Istanbul — Liverpool were 3–0 down at half-time and won on penalties
Bayern played in their own stadium (Allianz Arena) but lost — Chelsea won their first Champions League
The first final between two English clubs since 2008 — Mohamed Salah scored from the penalty spot in 2 minutes

leagues.name: Other Major Leagues
leagues.description: Major football leagues from across the globe

leagues.name: MLS (Major League Soccer)
leagues.notable: Growing league — signed Messi, Suarez and Ramos in recent years

leagues.name: Liga MX
leagues.notable: The most watched football league in the USA — bigger TV audience than the NFL in Spanish-language broadcasting

leagues.name: Brazilian Serie A
leagues.notable: Flamengo, Palmeiras, Sao Paulo, Santos — Brazil's clubs have produced the world's greatest players

leagues.name: Argentine Primera Division
leagues.notable: River Plate vs Boca Juniors — El Superclasico — is one of the most passionate derbies on Earth

leagues.name: Eredivisie
leagues.notable: Famous for developing talents — Ajax's academy has produced Cruyff, van Basten, Bergkamp and more

leagues.name: Primeira Liga
leagues.notable: Produced Cristiano Ronaldo, Eusebio, Luis Figo — Sporting CP and Benfica are historical powers

leagues.name: Scottish Premiership
leagues.notable: The Old Firm Derby — Celtic vs Rangers — is one of the most heated rivalries in world football

leagues.name: J1 League
leagues.notable: The top league in Asia — growing rapidly, now attracts former European stars
